name: layout
js: (() => { const de = document.documentElement, wide = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && (r.right > innerWidth + 0.5 || r.left < -0.5) && !e.closest('.tbl'); }).slice(0, 8).map(e => e.tagName + '.' + e.className + ' ' + Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().right)); const w = document.querySelector('.wrap'); return { scrollW: de.scrollWidth, innerW: innerWidth, hScroll: de.scrollWidth > innerWidth, gutter: getComputedStyle(w).paddingLeft, canvas: [document.getElementById('zs-canvas').width, document.getElementById('zs-canvas').style.width], coarse: matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches, keysShown: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.keys')).display, touchHint: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.keys-touch')).display, overflowing: wide }; })()

name: mobile-ended-first-screen
js: (scrollTo(0,0), new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => { const h = document.getElementById('zs-hold').getBoundingClientRect(); res({ hold: document.getElementById('zs-hold').innerText.replace(/\n/g, ' | '), holdTop: Math.round(h.top), holdBottom: Math.round(h.bottom), innerH: innerHeight, visible: h.bottom <= innerHeight }); }, 300)))

name: tap-again
js: new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => { const b = document.getElementById('zs-hold'); b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { button: 0, pointerId: 7, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { button: 0, pointerId: 7, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); setTimeout(() => res({ phaseAfterTap: __zs.state().phase, hold: b.innerText.replace(/\n/g, ' | ') }), 200); }, 500))
